hosted.holder: separate process holding a real CF owner; explicit failure, release by test file, second explicit copy succeeds
hosted.initial_failure: First hosted attempt returned OpenClipboard:1400 because Qt offscreen QWidget::winId is not a Win32 HWND; a hidden native owner window passed to the same SystemClipboardWriter fixed the test binding. Not a product copy failure.
hosted.personal_clipboard_guard: No local CF writes; hosted test only runs with the disposable runner guard and does not alter user desktop.

limitations: System CF verification is bound to the disposable GitHub-hosted Windows run above; local/offscreen cache is not CF evidence.
Wide/combining-character copy columns, full clipboard-occupancy product UX/retry policy, paste, Find, word/line selection, autoscroll, physical presentation/DPI and performance are not covered.
The hosted test uses a hidden native owner window because it runs offscreen; product code uses the widget's native handle in a real Qt window.
Old B/CD addressing, remote VM calibration/v2, A/B/C, old six-stage failure and #27/#29/#30/#7 remain unchanged.
